summary.text: Kristine Trow is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A fourth-generation Derry native who works as a healthcare professional, she lists public education, affordability and veterans' issues among her priorities.

paragraphs.text: Kristine Trow earned a high school diploma from Pinkerton Academy, graduated from Manchester Vocational College in 1990 and graduated from New Hampshire Technical Institute-Concord's Community College in 1992.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has spent more than 25 years as a Certified Dental Assistant, more than 12 years serving customers at Shaw's in Derry, and 12 years as a Mary Kay Sales Director.
Trow described herself in the survey as a fourth-generation Derry native, a parent and a grandparent.

She listed her key campaign messages as strengthening public education; lowering costs and supporting working families through affordable housing, healthcare and programs for seniors and children; and protecting communities, veterans and natural resources.
Trow advanced from the Democratic primary for Rockingham 13 on September 8, 2026.
